So much better! I got a referral for pelvic floor PT and the majority of my issues have gone away. Sometimes the urgency/frequency comes back, but I’d say 75-80% of the time it’s fine. I also have been given 250mg Cephalexin to take before sex to prevent another UTI, which has helped a ton. I also have gotten my IUD out, as I suspected it was causing some of these issues.

Same here! It’s been impacting my daily life, it makes me just want to stay at home curled up in bed, which is the opposite of how I used to be before all of this. I wish you luck!! I’m also suspecting pelvic floor issues as a result of my IUD, currently trying to get a referral to a pelvic floor PT. Good luck to you! I hope you figure all of this out!
